text: 学生证丢失后，应向学生事务中心提交补办申请，办理时需要携带身份证明。Student card replacement applications are handled by the Office of Student Affairs.
图书馆工作日开放时间为 8:00 至 22:00，周末开放时间为 9:00 至 20:00。Library hours are 8:00–22:00 on weekdays and 9:00–20:00 on weekends.
奖学金申请人应提交申请表和成绩单，并遵守校纪校规。Scholarship applicants must submit an application form and academic transcript.
教务处 Registry 位于教学楼 A 栋，可通过 registry@example.edu.cn 联系。The Registry is located in Teaching Building A.
金融学本科培养方案要求学生完成 120 学分。The Finance undergraduate programme requires 120 credits.
金融学专业必修课程包括公司金融和投资学。Required Finance courses include Corporate Finance and Investments.
校医务室提供日常健康咨询和基础医疗服务。
研究生院负责研究生学籍和培养事务。The Graduate School manages postgraduate registration and study matters.
